method: Three fresh hardware Chromium profiles per map and worker count, alternating order, local Vite HTTP server, no codec warmup, native memory sampled every ~100ms during loading. RSS and GPU resident counters overlap and must not be summed as unique memory. Peaks are sampled lower bounds.

sizeAwarePolicy: Pools ending in -small reserve one worker for textures above 2048*2048 pixels. Other workers never receive larger images, bounding their lifetime WASM heap growth. The reserved worker may also handle small jobs. These configurations were measured in a second batch after the uniform-worker comparison.
